scene: The cat purrs politely and paws open three departure gate doors.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view inside the wide booth along a floor line. Left, a striped rooftop gondola sways at an open gate. The girl stands mid-left, sketchbook under arm. Centre, the tuxedo cat sits before open doors showing a brass carousel train. Far right, an open hatch reveals a floating bubble lift.

a brass clockwork carousel train waiting on tracks behind centre doors
